topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The rain's been coming down harder than a confession on the wrong end of a .45. Got these flowers on my desk, no card, no note, nothin'. Just sitting there like a question I can't afford to ask. I've seen the way people's eyes light up right before they sink the knife in. This could be a peace offering, or it could be the calm before the storm. Doesn't change the fact that my gut's twisted like a broken tailpipe. I ditched the bottle for a reason, but the silence of an empty room's got me craving the noise. Might be time to hit the streets, see if the city's got any answers hiding in the shadows. But I already know the only one who's gonna save me is me, and I'm running low on options.
